title: Where each part runs
desc: On your machine runs the plugin: the skills you type in Claude Code, the driver that runs the steps, and the instructions for each AI role. On the server runs the workflow: the freeze that locks the tests, and the gate that runs them. The plugin starts the workflow, and the workflow reports back.
